items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And me and Lawrence Tocca(?), we played a series of parties for her.

ctx.x: begin to play for White folks. You play house parties. You play lawn parties. You play on the riverboats.

There were millions of house parties. You play the ....(?).... There was a woman in ...(?)., a White woman who used to give parties. And me and Lawrence Tocca(?), we played a series of parties for her.
